tests.assertion: test('4870全部17招逐实例有序编译与64种子基础，2057/2102两真实版本各16招完整用招，420明确阻塞',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');for(const id of[2057,2102]){const h=V(id),a=h.make({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(E.SOULS.registry[a.fighters[0].soulId].sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);assert.deepEqual(a.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.id===21822){assert.throws(()=>turn(a),/Q-4870-003/);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp);}else{turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp,'命中后魂印实际回复当招扣除的1PP');}}require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4870 base verified '+m.id);}assert.equal(require('../local-species.cjs').save(source).saved,false);});

tests.name: 4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复
tests.assertion: test('4870真实2057和2102选择保留各自hash，回初重复PP快照命中后恢复1PP再固定吸取320或360，技能禁疗不阻魂印理论回复',()=>{for(const [id,n]of[[2057,320],[2102,360]]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].requestedDrain,n);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppFrame2057.sourceHash,source.souls.find(s=>s.id===id).hash);}});

tests.name: 4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行
tests.assertion: test('4870真实两版恢复每一点PP分别减少80或40，含0槽与溢出，固定免疫不取消理论回复，已命中零红执行而MISS/整招无效/控制不执行',()=>{for(const id of[2057,2102]){const s=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);const n=id===2057?0:200;assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057[0].restored,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+n);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),0);const zero=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(zero,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero);assert.equal(sum(zero),0);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057.length,1);for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const a=V(id).make({move:10234,index:-1,soul:true,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(a,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')timer(a,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')a.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppSoulEvents2057,undefined);}}});

tests.name: 4870真实两版回初PP全不相等则当回合必暴，后续扣费造成相等不取消快照；PP倍率30或40依真实总量分档
